text.p: Thai media group Wattachak Plc said on Thursday it did not file its 1996 annual consolidated financial statement because the nature of transactions involving subsidiaries last year excluded them from the company's results.

Wattachak said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that it trimmed its equity holdings in Media Plus Plc and Thai Sky Cable TV Plc to 27.14 percent and 18.65 percent respectively during the third and fourth quarter of 1996.
Wattachak said its wholly owned Thai Press and Printing Co unit did not affect the group's financial position because it did not start operating last year.
Wattachak fell 1.50 baht to 13.50 early on Thursday. It has retreated sharply in recent weeks, declining from 36 baht a month ago.
The media company posted a 1996 unconsolidated net profit of 119.2 million baht, or 0.65 baht a share, sharply lower than 349.1 million, or 1.90 baht a year ago.
